body: ACCEPT the independent exact-main inventory amendment. core/transcript.scala already gives us checked AudioSpan, TranscriptTurn.audio, and turnAtAudio; this is a reusable text-first millisecond overlay. It is explicitly not an edition-aware clock, exact timebase/mapping contract, or timed-language lattice, and C1 must neither ignore it nor silently widen its semantics. The first portable substrate slice should preserve that API through conformance/adapter tests while introducing the richer types alongside it. The audit otherwise confirms no landed or pending code implementation of SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, MediaAtlas, multimodal evidence, timed tokens, AV tracks, worker schemas, FFmpeg/PySceneDetect, or movie runtime. Therefore the current admission ledger and D2 amendment remain documentation-only, and the first code plan remains provider-free substrate generalization rather than a competing movie ontology.
